400 Bad Request error when OCR input has an invalid image format

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import OcrRequest
from liter_llm import BadRequestError, LiterLlmError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        req = OcrRequest.from_json("{\"document\":{\"type\":\"document_url\",\"url\":\"invalid://url\"},\"model\":\"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest\"}")
        await client.ocr(req)
    except BadRequestError as error:
        print(f"BadRequestError: {error}")
    except LiterLlmError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
